title: Are you spotting? - heal360 pelvic floor leak hook
look: dark commercial gym, warm amber tungsten practicals, deep shadows, light haze, natural unretouched skin texture, 9:16 vertical, key action framed in the centre of frame
set_map: Flat bench runs north-south. A lies supine, head at the north end directly under the barbell, hands gripping the bar. B stands at the north end behind A's head, facing south toward A's feet. Rack uprights either side of A's head. Overhead practical lights.

cast.A: original character, lean athletic man early 30s, short curly dark hair, light stubble, fitted plain black t-shirt, black training shorts, white trainers
cast.B: original character, enormous competitive bodybuilder late 20s, dark brown skin, close-cropped black hair, clean-shaven, black deep-cut bodybuilding stringer vest, heather-grey sweat shorts, white trainers, black phone in both hands

continuity: same two men, same wardrobe, same gym, same amber grade as shot 1, positions match the set map, no face morphing, no outfit change

shots.angle: side-on from the east wall at bench height
shots.action: A presses a heavily loaded barbell, it stalls halfway up and his arms tremble; B stands behind A's head with eyes locked on his phone screen, thumb scrolling
shots.audio: gym hum, plates rattle, A strains

shots.angle: looking straight up past the shaking bar
shots.action: the trembling bar crosses the lower third of frame; B looms in the centre of frame above, face lit blue by his phone, thumb scrolling, eyes on the screen
shots.audio: phone tap sounds, B keeps scrolling with eyes on the screen

shots.angle: side-on on A's face at bench height
shots.action: A sucks in a huge breath, cheeks puff, face turns red as he bears down hard and drives the bar to full lockout, then his whole body freezes and his eyes widen slowly toward the ceiling
shots.audio: sharp inhale, bar clicks into lockout, then the gym hum drops away

shots.angle: low angle on B from bench height
shots.action: B slowly lowers his phone, his gaze travels down along A's body toward A's hips just below frame, eyebrows rise, flat deadpan stare

end_card_3s: Your pelvic floor is trainable - heal360
